symptom: The runtime-proven harness failed a standalone npx tsc --noEmit check under NodeNext resolution and without Node ambient types.
cause: SpacetimeDB's generated TypeScript bindings target bundler resolution, while the harness tsconfig selected NodeNext; @types/node was also absent.
remediation: Use ESNext plus Bundler resolution, permit imported .ts extensions, add Node ambient types, and rerun both harness and server no-emit checks successfully.
